title: A Multilingual, Large-Scale Study of the Interplay between LLM Safeguards, Personalisation, and Disinformation
reasoning: The paper empirically evaluates how Large Language Model safeguards respond to various disinformation narratives, specifically benchmarking 'religious' content which is shown to trigger higher refusal rates (Figure 4). Additionally, it analyzes the use of 'Moral' language across different demographic personas using psychological lexicons (Table 14), making religion and morality central components of the study's evaluation framework.
